Rise

AI Health & Fitness OS

Dashboard

Training

AI Coach

Wellbeing

Supplements

The Problem

Your health data is everywhere. And nowhere.

Sleep, nutrition, training load, stress — the signals that matter most are scattered across disconnected apps. Despite being deeply correlated, they never talk to each other.

The Insight

One experience. Every signal. AI that understands the connections.

Unifying workout tracking, macro logging, wearable data, and meditation with an AI coach that understands how these systems interact could fundamentally change how people manage their health.

The Prototype

A complete consumer health app — designed and prototyped end-to-end.

Built with Lovable. Integrates workout tracking, nutrition logging, wearable health data via third-party APIs, guided meditation, and AI-powered coaching in a single unified experience.

The Takeaway

The hardest design problem wasn't adding features — it was deciding what not to surface.

When every health signal is available, the AI coach becomes the editorial layer. The biggest unlock was shifting from "show all the data" to "show the one insight that matters today."

StayScape

AI‑Powered Travel Planning

Home

Plan a Trip

Destinations

Dashboard

Itinerary

The Problem

Planning a trip means juggling 5–10 different platforms.

Itineraries in one tab. Hotels in another. Activities somewhere else. Bookings in a fourth. The experience is fragmented, repetitive, and exhausting.

The Insight

One conversation. The entire trip.

A single conversational interface that consolidates itinerary creation, accommodation research, activity discovery, and booking — eliminating the tab-switching chaos of modern travel planning.

The Prototype

An AI travel planner that replaces the mess with a single flow.

Built with Lovable. Identified the core friction through personal experience planning complex multi-destination trips.

The Takeaway

Trust is the product — not the itinerary.

Users don't abandon trip planners because the suggestions are bad. They abandon them because they don't trust a single tool to replace their own research. The real design challenge is earning that trust incrementally.

BrewLab

AI Coffee Brewing Assistant

Landing

Recipes

Ratio

Timer

Shop

The Problem

Recipes are scattered. Adjusting them is a nightmare.

Coffee brewing knowledge lives across YouTube videos and blog posts with no standardization. When you want to scale a recipe or tweak a ratio for a different brew method, you are on your own with a calculator.

The Insight

Precision brewing shouldn't require expertise. Just good tools.

A structured recipe library with dynamic ratio calculation, guided brew timers, and method-specific recommendations could turn any home brewer into a consistent one.

The Prototype

Guided recipes, precision ratios, and a step-by-step brew timer — in one app.

Built with Lovable. Covers V60, AeroPress, and Cold Brew with curated recipes from competition winners and specialty coffee experts. Includes a ratio calculator, guided timer, and a curated bean shop.

The Takeaway

The best recipe tool isn't the one with the most recipes — it's the one you actually follow.

Structured step-by-step guidance with a built-in timer changes behaviour in a way that a static recipe page never does. The product isn't the information; it's the workflow.
